source: Official n8n repository, master branch inspected through web browsing
observations: For resource message and operation send, GmailV2 sets responseData to the Gmail API response.
The shared return path wraps responseData using returnJsonArray and attaches paired-item metadata using constructExecutionMetaData.
That path does not merge the incoming item JSON into the output. Paired-item linkage is not preservation of its JSON fields.
The seven specialty exports read scoring fields from current $json immediately after Send Email, so those fields are absent under the inspected official implementation.
The two hormone exports already reference Build HTML Email explicitly in success responses and avoid this specific problem.
recommendedRepair: Read result fields explicitly from Calculate Scores or Build HTML Email, or merge assessment data with the Gmail response before Respond - Success.
limitation: The deployed n8n server version and live output were not inspected. No Gmail API operation or workflow execution was performed.
